defects.impact: removes forward search from the campaign entirely
defects.symptom: SIGSEGV / core dump; parent episodes truncated after 1-2 decisions
defects.root_cause: env.clone() copies the Python wrapper but both wrappers address the same native libcg.so game state, so advancing a clone destroys the parent
defects.fix: abandoned forward simulation; search runs at depth 0 as a heuristic ranker
defects.residual: PERMANENT — this is a property of the simulator, not of c017 code. Probe P10 records it and every downstream artifact is tainted by it.

defects.impact: agent errored on the first decision of every game; 0 games completed
defects.symptom: AttributeError, visible only as engine agent status ERROR
defects.root_cause: empty bench/active slots arrive as None entries rather than absent entries
defects.fix: filter None slots in every zone reader

defects.impact: 249 of 266 searches aborted before scoring any candidate
defects.symptom: search silently fell through to the baseline fallback
defects.root_cause: the per-decision node cap was tested against a GLOBAL counter, so the budget was spent once for the entire run

defects.impact: every game marked ERROR and its true outcome destroyed
defects.symptom: TypeError AFTER the episode ran; the except-block then overwrote the observed statuses with ERROR
defects.root_cause: rewards are None when an episode ends abnormally, and the error handler discarded the real evidence
defects.fix: compute outcome only when both rewards exist; never overwrite observed statuses
defects.lesson: the most damaging defect was in the ERROR HANDLING, not the pipeline: it destroyed the evidence needed to diagnose the others

defects.impact: TypeError on every game during redaction
defects.root_cause: sorted() over card ids where some entries are None
features were captured with cg.policy_features while TorchPolicy consumes the state_encoder_v2 representation; the two are not interchangeable
defects.fix: capture state_encoder_v2 features and pad ragged option arrays to a fixed width

ranked_by: impact on the campaign's ability to run the vertical at all

consolidated_repair_pass.note: §7 allows at most one consolidated repair pass. All six defects were repaired in that single pass; the first is permanently unfixable because it is a simulator property.
